record.field: The download format "%(format)s" requires a processing.
The processing of format "%(format)s" is only allowed for downloads.
A format with the BTF parameters "%(btf)s" already exists (format "%(format)s").
Format "%(format)s" can only be imported as statement for message camt.053.
The URL of EBICS connection "%(configuration)s" must start with "https://".
The combination of host ID, partner ID and user ID must be unique per company.
The value of "%(field)s" of EBICS connection "%(configuration)s" must consist of 64 hexadecimal characters.
A format can be added only once to an EBICS connection.
A bank account can be released only once per EBICS connection.
The bank account "%(bank_account)s" has no IBAN.
The company of account "%(account)s" must be the company of EBICS connection "%(configuration)s".
